CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shadow_predictions (
	decision_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	application_id VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	model_sha256 VARCHAR(64), 
	probability FLOAT, 
	baseline_log_odds FLOAT, 
	age_shap_log_odds FLOAT, 
	reason_codes JSON NOT NULL, 
	raw_margin FLOAT, 
	comparison_threshold FLOAT, 
	policy_outcome VARCHAR(24) NOT NULL, 
	disagreement BOOLEAN, 
	error_type VARCHAR(80), 
	created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (decision_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(decision_id) REFERENCES decisions (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(application_id) REFERENCES applications (id)
)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_shadow_predictions_application_id ON shadow_predictions (application_id)
